name: demo-decision
description: Demo "Waiting on you": a bug fix that reproduces and fixes a validator bug, then raises request_decision (test=data) about backfilling production claims and ends its turn. Resumed with the answer it branches on the chosen label: "Backfill production now", "Rehearse on UAT first" or "Skip the backfill".

steps.text: Declaring the plan for the policy-number fix.

args.summary: Legacy policy numbers (P-123456) are rejected since Monday; fix the validator and repair the rejected claims.

tasks.title: Reproduce the legacy policy-number rejection in a test
Accept legacy formats in the validator
Document the incident and the fix

evidence.detail: Legacy P-###### numbers accepted alongside the current format

steps.text: Re-submitting rejected claims changes production data, so this needs the Approver.

args.question: 1,284 claims were rejected by the policy-number bug since Monday. Re-submit them to production now?

options.label: Backfill production now
options.description: Re-submit all 1,284 claims through the fixed validator tonight.

options.label: Rehearse on UAT first
options.description: Run the backfill on the UAT copy, compare results, then decide.

options.label: Skip the backfill
options.description: Leave rejected claims for customers to resubmit.

recommendation.rationale: The backfill touches production data; a UAT rehearsal costs one day and shows exact outcomes first.

args.context: Validator fix verified by test/claims/validate.test.ts; 1,284 rejected claims across 3 days.

steps.text: Decision {{decision.decision_id}} is with the Approver; ending my turn until it is answered.
Approved: writing the production backfill job.
Rehearsing on UAT as decided: writing the backfill job against the UAT copy.
steps.label: uat

input.content:
# Backfill rehearsal on UAT

<!-- build {{sim.sessionId}} -->

Run scripts/backfill-rejected-claims.ts with TARGET=uat, then compare accepted counts with production rejections.

evidence.detail: Rehearsal job targets UAT; production backfill waits for the comparison

steps.text: Skipping the backfill as decided; taking it out of this plan.
steps.label: skip

args.reason: The Approver decided to skip the production backfill.
